_comment: The literal featureFlags/monthlyStory control document, minus updatedAt. parseMonthlyStoryControl (functions/src/monthlyStoryControl.ts) requires EXACTLY these 26 fields plus updatedAt = 27; any extra or missing key is 'malformed' and fails closed to SAFE_DISABLED_MONTHLY_STORY_CONTROL. updatedAt is stamped by apply-monthly-story-config.mjs at write time because the parser rejects any document older than MONTHLY_STORY_CONTROL_MAX_AGE_MS (24h) as 'stale'. This _comment key is stripped before writing.
